exposure: Estimated fetal weight (EFW) or fetal abdominal circumference (FAC) <10th centile (SGA)
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome (CAPO) (perinatal death, birth asphyxia, major neonatal morbidity)
cohort: Singleton small-for-gestational age (SGA) pregnancies, defined by estimated fetal weight or fetal abdominal circumference <10th centile.
finding: Low EFW MoM and UCR effectively identified perinatal risk, with the RCT-eligible group experiencing lower birthweight and higher CAPO, suggesting that early delivery for abnormal UCR in SGA fetuses at 34-36 weeks should only be considered within clinical trials.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight or fetal abdominal circumference <10th centile (SGA)
